name: voxelsieve
description: Analyse industrial CT scans on your own computer: porosity against acceptance limits, wall thickness, comparison with the CAD model, first article inspection, battery cells, fibre composites and reports

scan_dir.title: Scan directory
scan_dir.description: Directory with your CT scans; created when missing. VoxelSieve reads and writes only inside it, including its projects and reports.

vs_gui.title: VoxelSieve program
vs_gui.description: Path to vs-gui from the VoxelSieve release (bin/vs-gui, or bin\vs-gui.exe on Windows), or just vs-gui when it is on the PATH.
